moments.text: Handheld recording of an infrared screen, shown small inside black borders: light grey above a darker lower band, a small dark spot in a box at the crosshair.
The view zooms in quickly; the crosshair bars spread and the boxed spot grows.
The boxed dark spot stays at the crosshair just above the darker lower band while the view drifts and slowly zooms closer.
The spot fades: the box turns into empty corner brackets while a faint trace lingers just above them, gone by 29.9 s.
Empty brackets sit at the crosshair over mottled dark patches, then vanish.
The bare crosshair sweeps over the darker mottled band; no spot is visible, only a small white x marker now and then.
